nodes.label: EMERGEN Monorepo Structure (Evidencias de sistema Aplicación)
nodes.norm_label: emergen monorepo structure (evidencias de sistema aplicacion)

nodes.label: EMERGEN Project (Ecosistema Multiplataforma de Alertas)
nodes.rationale: Reduces waiting times and lack of information during emergencies (medical, domestic, urban accidents) by delivering real-time location, context and medical data to rescue personnel; also enables traceability and management of response teams.

nodes.label: Docker-based Deployment Strategy for EMERGEN
nodes.rationale: Docker is used to guarantee portability and avoid local dependency conflicts across team members; the monorepo apps are exported from the same code and run in a controlled environment to prevent data inconsistency. Noted as a Phase-1 Capstone mockup of the infrastructure to speed up implementation later.

nodes.label: Microservices + Monorepo Layered Architecture
nodes.rationale: Layered architecture (data/business/presentation) chosen so the three client interfaces (web, mobile, desktop) share the same logic and design base via Ionic/TypeScript, while a centralized Nest.js REST API handles business logic and external service integration (Google Maps, PayPal, Twilio, jsReport).
